test_development_findings: An existing stochastic symbolic comparison xfailed during one full-suite run. Replaced its approximately-20-failure adaptive-MC heuristic with an independent exact Stim response convolution and seeded fixed-budget binomial check; final full suite has no xfails.

Initial independent replay code tested ordinary root probabilities and skipped an underflowed low weight. Corrected it to inspect log support and added a regression requiring both low and typical weights to be checked.

Intermediate BB144 nonuniform MC was stopped after more than fifteen minutes during the third fixed-budget point. Two complete points and the unfinished-state record are preserved in before_log_audit_fix.

An RNG-zero endpoint and deterministic zero-weight-suffix guard were added during validation; per-case source hashes identify versions when captured. Final endpoint, joint-distribution and full regression checks passed.
The Stim 1.16 environment initially imported an older installed package. Repeated the check against this source tree using PYTHONPATH; all 99 selected tests passed.

release.reason: Large-code finite-grid accuracy and QLDPC time/memory limits remain unresolved.

native_scope: No C++ source changed in this follow-up. Existing native-binding/fault-response regressions are included in the full suite; sanitizer CI was not executed locally.
